Analysis: Hypothesis 1 offers a highly novel two‐pronged approach by coupling tumor cell ferroptosis with the emerging idea of LDLR-mediated TCR recycling in CD8+ T cells. This dual mechanism is imaginative but relies on less established and more speculative links, particularly the connection between LDLR expression and TCR dynamics. In contrast, Hypothesis 2, while slightly less groundbreaking, builds on a more straightforward mechanistic narrative where PCSK9 overexpression drives MHC class I degradation and favorable lipid metabolic changes to shield tumor cells from ferroptosis. This pathway is accompanied by the recognized modality of PD-1 blockade. Thus, Hypothesis 2 is overall more plausible and testable with established methods, while also affording a clearer safety monitoring framework given its defined effects on antigen presentation and metabolism.
